subject: tr
title: TR.------EXT.FT.
description: Chart on book p. 470 (TRF(II)-6). TR (transformation) is the subject; EXT-FT (extended functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics), SOC-RT (social reality) and POST (postulation). From VT-DY: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From CULT-AF-BS: PRI-INFO (principle information). From PRI-INFO: RE-CONT (recontinuance). From SOC-RT: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From RT-INT-TR: REL-TECH (relevant technology). From REL-TECH: SPT-AW (spiritual awareness). From POST: MOT-DY. From MOT-DY: INFT-DT.
